title: add rag agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs update
author: Asha Patel
description:
Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples plus docs site updates. Motivation: make it easy for developers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents that call external tools (search, DB, and actions) using the new agents SDK. This PR provides 3 quickstarts (Node, Python, and a standalone example), a set of RAG templates (prompt + retrieval hooks), sample tool definitions (search, vector-db, email-sender), and docs/site updates (sidebar, quickstart index, and example walkthroughs).

What changed (high-level):
- new examples/redwood-agent-rag-node/ and examples/redwood-agent-rag-python/ quickstarts
- templates/rag-templates/* prompt templates and YAML examples for retrieval config
- examples/tools/* sample tool stubs and test harness
- docs site: quickstarts page, sidebar, and code snippets updated to include tool-calling flow

Checklist:
- [x] Add cross-language quickstarts (Node/Python)
- [x] Add RAG prompt templates and retrieval adapters
- [x] Add sample tool definitions and test harness
- [x] Update docs site, sidebar, and quickstart index
- [x] Add basic unit tests for examples where applicable

Testing notes: manual end-to-end verified with local vector DB (FAISS) and mock search tool; verified streaming and tool-call example responses in both Node and Python quickstarts. CI runs include lint, unit tests for examples, and docs build.

Related Linear: ENG-4021 (RAG agents quickstarts), DOC-918 (docs site quickstart index). Related support ticket: SUP-732 (customer asked for examples with tool calling).
